localeCode.description: Don't translate. Set to this file's locale folder name, such as de or pt_BR.

extDescription.message: A side pane with notes and todos for every tab and tab group, synced to Todoist.
extDescription.description: Extension description in the store and extensions page.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button that opens the side pane.

commandOpen.description: Keyboard shortcut description on the browser's shortcuts page.

pageTitle.description: Side pane document title before a tab is shown.

emptyTitle.description: Heading when there's no active tab.

emptyBody.message: Select a tab to see its notes and tasks.
emptyBody.description: Text when there's no active tab.

groupPaneLabel.description: Accessible name of the tab group section.

tabPaneLabel.description: Accessible name of the tab section.

untitledGroup.description: Shown for a tab group that has no name.

newTab.description: Shown for a tab that has no title or address.

localFile.description: Shown under a tab's title when it shows a file on the computer.

tabCount_one.description: Number of tabs in a group, singular. $1 is the number.

tabCount_other.description: Number of tabs in a group, plural. $1 is the number.

openTasks_one.description: Number of tasks not completed, singular. $1 is the number.

openTasks_other.description: Number of tasks not completed, plural. $1 is the number.

notesPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the empty notes box.

addTaskPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the box that adds a task.

addTaskLabel.message: Add a task. Press Enter to add, Shift+Enter for a new line.
addTaskLabel.description: Screen reader label of the box that adds a task.

taskTitleLabel.message: Task title. Press Enter to save, Shift+Enter for a new line.
taskTitleLabel.description: Screen reader label of a task's editable title.

completed.description: Heading of the collapsible list of completed tasks.

markCompleted.description: Tooltip of a task's round checkbox.

markNotCompleted.description: Tooltip of a completed task's checkbox.

markImportant.description: Tooltip of a task's star button.

removeImportance.description: Tooltip of a starred task's star button.

deleteTask.description: Tooltip of a task's delete button.

setUpSync.description: Footer button that opens sync setup.

signIn.description: Footer button when sync is set up but the user is signed out.

syncPitch.message: Sync notes and tasks to Todoist.
syncPitch.description: Footer status when sync isn't set up.

signInExpired.description: Footer status when the user must sign in again.

connected.description: Footer status after signing in, before the first sync.

syncedAt.description: Footer status after a sync. $1 is a time, such as 11:45 AM.

syncFailed.description: Footer status when sync fails. $1 is the error message.

close.description: Tooltip of the setup window's close button.

notNow.description: Link that closes the setup window without setting up sync.

connectBody.message: Your notes and tasks go to a Todoist project, with a task for every tab and tab group that has notes. Use them in Todoist on your phone, computer, and the web.
connectBody.description: Setup window text before signing in.

doneTitle.description: Setup window title after signing in.

signedInAs.description: $1 is the user's email address or name.

yourAccount.description: Used in 'Signed in as $1' when the account name is unknown.

doneBody.message: Notes and tasks sync to the **$1** project in Todoist. Each tab group is a task named **$2** and each tab a task named **$3**, with your tasks as its subtasks.
doneBody.description: Setup window text after signing in. $1 is the project name, $2 and $3 are example task names.

groupNamePlaceholder.description: Stands for a tab group's name in an example Todoist task name.

pageTitlePlaceholder.description: Stands for a web page's title in an example Todoist task name.

done.description: Button that closes the setup window.

manageTitle.description: Title of the sync settings window.

signOut.description: Button that signs out of Todoist.

todoistTaskGroup.description: Name of the Todoist task for a tab group. $1 is the group's name. **...** is bold in Todoist; keep the brackets.

todoistTaskTab.description: Name of the Todoist task for a tab. $1 is the page title. **...** is bold in Todoist; keep the brackets.

untitledPage.description: Used in a Todoist task name when the page has no title.

errCanceled.description: Error when the user closes the sign-in window.

errAuthPage.message: The Todoist sign-in page couldn't finish. Try again.
errAuthPage.description: Error when the Todoist sign-in window fails.

errNoResponse.message: The extension didn't respond. Try reopening the side pane.
errNoResponse.description: Error when the background script doesn't answer.

errNotesGone.message: These notes are no longer available.
errNotesGone.description: Error when editing notes that were removed.

errSignInAgain.message: Sign in again to keep syncing.

errNotSignedIn.description: Error when syncing while signed out.

errStateMismatch.message: Sign-in couldn't be verified. Try again.
errStateMismatch.description: Error when the sign-in response doesn't match the request.

todoistProject.description: Name of the Todoist project that holds all notes. Don't translate.

signInWithTodoist.description: Setup window button that opens Todoist sign-in.

todoistAccount.description: Shown when the signed-in Todoist account has no display name.

errRegister.message: Couldn't connect to Todoist. Try again later.
errRegister.description: Error when the extension can't register itself with Todoist.

syncedToTodoist.message: Synced to Todoist. Click to open it in Todoist.
syncedToTodoist.description: Tooltip of the cloud icon on notes or a task that is in Todoist.

pendingSync.description: Tooltip of the cloud icon on notes or a task whose changes haven't reached Todoist yet.

todoistProjectLegacy1.description: Earlier name of the Todoist project, used to find and rename existing projects. Keep the old translation; never change it.

deleteNotes.description: Tooltip of the button that deletes the notes.

deleteSection.description: Tooltip of the button that deletes a tab's or tab group's notes and tasks.

confirmDeleteGroup.message: Delete this tab group's notes and tasks?
confirmDeleteGroup.description: Confirmation question before deleting a tab group's notes and tasks. The browser tab group itself stays open.

confirmDeleteTab.message: Delete this tab's notes and tasks?
confirmDeleteTab.description: Confirmation question before deleting a tab's notes and tasks. The tab itself stays open.

confirmAlsoTodoist.message: They'll be deleted from Todoist too.
confirmAlsoTodoist.description: Second line of a delete confirmation when the item is also in Todoist.

cancel.description: Button that closes a confirmation without doing anything.

reorderTask.message: Drag to reorder. Or press Alt+Up or Alt+Down in the task.
reorderTask.description: Tooltip of a task's drag handle.

settingsTitle.description: Title of the settings window and tooltip of the gear button.

closeActionLabel.message: When a tab with notes closes
closeActionLabel.description: Heading of the setting for what happens to a tab's notes and tasks when the tab closes.

closeActionAsk.message: Ask whether to delete its notes and tasks

closeActionKeep.description: Option: keep the notes and tasks.

closeActionDelete.description: Option: delete the notes and tasks (also in Todoist).

rememberChoice.description: Checkbox in the closed-tab prompt that saves the choice as the setting.

keep.description: Button that keeps a closed tab's notes and tasks.

closedOne.message: You closed "$1". Delete its notes and tasks?
closedOne.description: Prompt after closing a tab that had notes. $1 is the tab's title.

closedMany_other.message: You closed $1 tabs with notes. Delete their notes and tasks?
closedMany_other.description: Prompt after closing several tabs that had notes. $1 is the number of tabs.

tasksHeading.description: Heading that collapses or expands the task list. Followed by the number of open tasks.

syncDone.description: Shown in Settings after Sync now succeeds.

aboutLine.description: Bottom of Settings. $1 is the extension name, $2 the version, $3 the publisher (Stark Industries, don't translate).

nothingToSync.message: Nothing to sync. Changes made in Todoist are pulled in automatically.
nothingToSync.description: Tooltip of the grayed-out Sync now button.

todoistTaskGroupLegacy1.description: Earlier format of the tab group task name, used to find and rename existing tasks. Never change it.

todoistTaskTabLegacy1.description: Earlier format of the tab task name, used to find and rename existing tasks. Never change it.
